ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Data related to an integrated circuit card application.

PaymentContext.name: Payment Context
PaymentContext.definition: Context of the card payment transaction.

AdditionalService.name: Additional Service
AdditionalService.definition: Service in addition to the main service.

TransactionCategory.name: Transaction Category
TransactionCategory.definition: Category code conform to ISO 18245, related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction.|This element is also known as the MerchantCategoryCode.

SaleReconciliationIdentification.name: Sale Reconciliation Identification
SaleReconciliationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the sales reconciliation period between the acceptor and the acquirer. This identification might be linked to the identification of the settlement for further verification by the merchant.

SaleReferenceNumber.name: Sale Reference Number
SaleReferenceNumber.definition: Unique reference of the sales as provided by the merchant.

RePresentmentReason.name: Re Presentment Reason
RePresentmentReason.definition: Reason for representment of a card transaction.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Sequential number of the card transaction, as assigned by the POI (Point of Interaction). |Usage: The sequential number is increased incrementally for each transaction.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the POI (Point Of Interaction).

ValidationDate.name: Validation Date
ValidationDate.definition: Date when the deposit was validated by the financial institution that collected the cash.

ValidationSequenceNumber.name: Validation Sequence Number
ValidationSequenceNumber.definition: Sequential number of the validation of the cash deposit.|Usage: The sequential number is increased incrementally for each transaction.
